hero.eyebrow: A flashcard app for learning that lasts
hero.title:
Study quietly.
Remember everything.
hero.lede: JustFlip! is a spaced-repetition flashcard app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Curate your decks on the desktop, review them on the go, and let an SM-2-inspired engine surface the right card at the right moment.
hero.floatPillText: New — generate decks with your favorite AI agent
devices.title:
One library.
Three companions.
devices.kicker: Capture and curate on the Mac. Review on the iPhone over morning coffee. Annotate on the iPad in the margins. iCloud keeps every card, every interval and every streak in perfect sync — without ever asking you to think about it.
devices.stageLabel: Image · iPhone, iPad & Mac with synced decks
devices.macosDesc: Import .flashcard archives by drag-and-drop, manage interests, edit cards in a dedicated editor.
devices.ipadosDesc: A wide canvas for long-form review sessions with Pencil-friendly typography and split view.
devices.iosDesc: Daily reviews, a quiet widget on the home screen, and progress tracked card-by-card.
ai.title: Let the AI write the deck.
ai.kicker: Two ways to create decks — full rich-content cards with agentic coding tools, or simple text-only sets directly in ChatGPT.
ai.terminalAria: Terminal demo of generating a flashcard deck with an AI agent
ai.richDesc: Generate decks with images, audio, and Markdown formatting. Requires an agentic coding tool like Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode.
ai.textDesc: Quick text-only flashcards — no images or audio. Use the JustFlip GPT in ChatGPT, or copy the same prompt into Claude or Gemini.
study.title: A library you can swipe through.
study.kicker: Browse decks as a calm, editorial list — or enter a focused review and judge each card with a Tinder-style swipe. Right for good, left for again, up for easy. The flow stays in your hand.
algorithm.title:
A patient algorithm.
Five states. Lasting recall.
algorithm.kicker: JustFlip! runs a refined SM-2 engine across five learning states. Cards travel through unseen, learning, reviewing, relearning and graduated, each with its own interval and ease. Urgency tells you what is most worth your time today.
algorithm.unseenDesc: Never studied — ready for first contact.
algorithm.learningDesc: Minutes to a day. Fresh memory taking shape.
algorithm.reviewingDesc: Days to weeks. The interval grows by ease.
algorithm.relearningDesc: Forgotten? Back to short intervals, gently.
algorithm.formulaNote: Ease grows on easy, settles on good, and contracts on hard or again — never below 1.3.
science.title:
Not just flipping cards.
A proven way to remember.
science.kicker: Decades of memory research — popularized in the bestselling book Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning — point to one conclusion: we remember by retrieving, not rereading, and by spacing practice over time. JustFlip! turns that science into a daily habit.
science.chartLabel: Chart comparing how memory fades after a single cram versus spaced review
science.chartNote: Each review lifts recall and flattens the curve of forgetting.
science.retrievalDesc: Every card asks you to pull the answer from memory before you flip — that effort is what makes it stick.
science.spacingTitle: Let a little forgetting work for you
science.spacingDesc: Reviews return just as memory starts to fade, when each repetition does the most good — the SM-2 engine's quiet job.
science.interleaveDesc: Shuffling topics in one session feels harder — and builds memory that lasts far longer than studying in blocks.
science.difficultyDesc: Judging each card Again, Hard, Good or Easy keeps reviews honestly challenging — the kind of effort that deepens learning.
science.quote: “Learning is deeper and more durable when it's effortful.”
science.quoteAttr: — Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning
markdown.title: Cards that read like essays.
markdown.kicker: Define your cards in rich Markdown — headings, lists, code blocks, inline math, images and links. JustFlip! renders them with editorial typography so a card can be a one-line cue or a small piece of scholarship.
markdown.label: Image · Markdown-rich card definition
audio.title: Decks that speak.
audio.kicker: Let your cards read themselves out loud while you walk, cook, or drive. JustFlip!'s home-screen widget keeps the next review one tap away — a small, golden invitation to five minutes of practice.
theme.title:
Dark by candlelight.
Light by morning.
theme.kicker: JustFlip! respects the system. Switch from a deep, scholarly dark to a soft parchment light — the gold and slate stay true at any hour.
access.title: Learning, for every learner.
access.kicker: JustFlip! is built to work with the tools people rely on — so a deck is just as usable with a screen reader, at any text size, by ear, or in your own language.
access.voiceDesc: Navigate every deck with VoiceOver — cards, controls and each learning state are clearly labeled.
access.speakDesc: Text-to-speech reads your cards aloud for eyes-free, low-vision and dyslexia-friendly study.
access.typeDesc: Respects your system text size, so cards and layout scale up without ever breaking.
access.contrastDesc: The five learning states are set apart by label and position — never color alone — with a dedicated high-contrast mode in the works.
access.langDesc: The whole app — and this very page — is localized into nine languages.
access.langList: English · Deutsch · Español · Français · Italiano · Português · 日本語 · 한국어 · Čeština

cta.lede: One purchase. Three platforms. A lifetime of well-spaced review.

prompt.metaTitle: JustFlip! AI Prompt for Claude and Gemini
prompt.metaDescription: Describe the deck you want, copy one prompt into Claude, Gemini, or any chat AI, and get an importable JustFlip .flashcards file back.
prompt.eyebrow: For Claude, Gemini and any chat AI
prompt.title:
Describe it.
Get a JustFlip deck.
prompt.lede: Type what you want to learn. We bundle your request with the JustFlip build instructions so any chat AI returns an importable .flashcards file. ChatGPT has a ready-made JustFlip GPT — Claude Projects and Gemini Gems can't be shared publicly, so this page gives you the same instructions as one copyable prompt.
prompt.panelText: You only write your topic or notes. The button adds the technical build instructions behind them — you can expand and read those anytime. Nothing is sent anywhere; the prompt is just copied to your clipboard.
prompt.editorTitle: Describe the deck you want to study.
prompt.editorKicker: Write a topic, paste your notes, an article or a lecture transcript. When you copy, your text is bundled with the JustFlip build instructions — paste the whole thing into a new Claude or Gemini chat.
prompt.techSummary: Show the instructions added to your request
prompt.techHint: read-only · added automatically when you copy
prompt.editorNote: After the AI saves the .flashcards file, download it and open it with JustFlip to import the deck.
prompt.step1Text: Type your topic or paste your notes in the box above, then hit Copy full prompt.
prompt.step2Text: Open Claude or Gemini in a new chat and paste. Your request and the build instructions go together.
prompt.step3Text: The AI returns a .flashcards file. Download it and open it with JustFlip.
prompt.copySuccess: Full prompt copied — paste it into Claude or Gemini.
prompt.copyFail: Could not copy automatically. Expand the instructions, select the text and copy it manually.
